scope: All 125 agreed decisions, all 28 requirement groups, and all 97 candidate contracts. Local evidence never substitutes for final native acceptance.

native_dimensions.scenario: Exercise ApplicationV2 open, close, reload, resize, focus and retained drafts in the actual Foundry client.
Use GM and independently authenticated player clients to inspect packs, documents, public DTOs and denied requests.
Submit forged senders, protected identifiers, malformed payloads, replayed requests and revoked Actor ownership across real sockets.
Transfer the designated writer during asynchronous requests and reconcile original uncertain effects without duplicate native creation.
Restart world and clients around prepared/completed journals, retained events and partial batches; verify original provenance and no replay.
Execute approved Actor, Item, Journal, Chat, Combat and Roll workflows, including unknown acknowledgements and separate graph activation.
Execute the exact advertised system/version/build policy, test mismatches, and verify original roll reuse plus observer-safe publication.
Upgrade representative legacy native pages, interrupt migration and index repair, resume, and preserve drafts, published snapshots and history.
Measure bounded indexed event routing, page loading, temporal catch-up and selective staleness with recorded world sizes, limits and timings.
Inspect actual player wire traffic and native document payloads for hidden text, protected IDs, audience data and cross-observer inference.
Race delegated GM saves, publications, activation and role loss; verify revision conflicts, immutable versions and original unknown requests.
Execute every TEST-ADR scenario with real native storage and clients, including optional native bindings, crossplot fanout and recovery.

compatibility_targets.basis: Author-requested module manifest convention; system/browser/platform are unknown and no executed compatibility is asserted.
